item.title: The Indy Endorsement: The Honey Cake at Family Bakery
item.description: It consists of very thin layers of honey sponge cake, with each layer separated by a slightly tart cream filling. The predominant flavor is like a caramelized honey—but the cake is not actually all that sweet, and the texture is wonderfully soft without being at all mushy. The Indy Endorsement: The Honey Cake at Family Bakery is a story from Coachella Valley Independent, the Coachella Valley's alternative news source.

item.title: Celebrating Success: Aloe Blacc, One of the Best Modern Soul/Pop Voices, Is Coming to Palm Springs for a Special Performance
item.description: Blacc is setting out on a three-city run of shows dubbed the “Wake Me Up Tour.” After a three-night residency at New York’s iconic Blue Note Jazz Club, followed by a weekend at Blue Note Los Angeles, Blacc will visit the Plaza Theatre on Monday, Feb. 16. item.title: Vine Social: Want Romance? The Best Place to Find It Is NOT at a Restaurant on Valentine’s Day
item.description: Here’s the part no one tells you about dining out on Valentine’s Day: Restaurants are sprinting. You’re not luxuriating.
